ios.desc:
Your AI companion, your music, your money, your photos — four agents in your pocket, working together on one local engine and one shared memory, paired with your Mac. Your data stays on hardware you own.

YINYUE — YOUR COMPANION
Talk with Yinyue, the spirit companion of Linggen. She remembers you across conversations, plays your music, tidies your photos, and answers about your spending — right on the phone. Anything technical she hands to the agent on your Mac.

DJ — YOUR MUSIC, EVERYWHERE
Your library, synced from your Mac and kept for offline listening. Playlists, karaoke lyrics, and CarPlay with live lyrics in Now Playing.

CFO — YOUR MONEY, PRIVATELY
Transactions, budgets, and trends on the phone. Share a bank statement into the app and it lands in your books. No account linking — your statements never touch a server.

SHIFU — YOUR PHONE'S KEEPER
Storage health, photo cleanup, space to reclaim. Deletions always go through the system confirmation — nothing leaves without your say.

PAIRED WITH YOUR MAC, NOT WITH A CLOUD
Install Linggen on your Mac and scan one QR code. Phone and Mac then talk peer-to-peer over an encrypted channel on your network — music, photos, files, and memory sync with no server between your devices. The phone keeps working with the Mac asleep, and reaches Ling — the Mac-side agent — the moment it wakes.

LOCAL-FIRST, OPEN AT THE ROOT
Linggen means "spirit root" — the root system your agents grow from. The engine it runs on is open source. Your files, memory, and agents stay on hardware you own. Bring your own AI model: your existing ChatGPT subscription, a local model on your Mac, or an API key.

The full guide lives at linggen.dev/guide.

2. "Can you draft an email to Air Canada for the duplicated charge?"
